title: Final Answer for (a)
description: Essential Criteria: The expression for the constraint force must be correctly derived as a constant multiplied by (1 + 4r^2/a^2)^(-3/2).

title: Direction of Force
description: Important Criteria: The direction of the constraint force must be identified as being perpendicular to the inside surface of the paraboloid.

title: Lagrangian Setup
description: Essential Criteria: The Lagrangian function must be correctly set up in spherical coordinates for the rotating frame.

title: Velocity-Dependent Potential
description: Important Criteria: The addition of the velocity-dependent potential U must be correctly shown in the Lagrangian.

title: Centrifugal Force Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The components of the centrifugal force must be accurately calculated and expressed in terms of r and omega.

title: Coriolis Force Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The components of the Coriolis force must be accurately calculated and expressed in terms of r and omega.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Watch for common errors such as sign mistakes or incorrect expressions for forces or potentials.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: Ensure that all terms are consistent in units throughout the calculations.
